programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: It's the first day of the competition in Worcestershire and fitness enthusiast Claire Wier is producing a low-fat menu for her guests, Tim, Teresa, Chris, and Pippa. Claire remains confident and oblivious all evening, despite her guests moaning about the lack of cream, fat, oil and butter in her meal. As if healthy eating wasn't enough, Claire has her guests working up their appetite with an aerobic workout.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

The main goes down well with foodie Teresa, who thinks it very flavoursome, but not so well with moaner Chris.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Pork Steaks and Killer KedgereeJamie rustles up pork steaks, Hungarian pepper sauce and rice, plus killer kedgeree, beans, greens and chilli yoghurt.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: S3 E2 — Stanley TucciIna and actor/director Stanley Tucci kick off their day together with easy oysters Rockefeller and martinis; there's a Tucci kitchen takeover when Stanley teaches Ina how to make an incredible Tuscan seafood stew, cacciucco.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S12 E3 — Bread WeekThis week it's time to bake bread, and the remaining bakers have a lot to prove. They put their own twist on a classic Italian focaccia in the Signature and head slightly further east in the technical, making a Greek-inspired snack.

programme.title: Rachel Allen: Bake!
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Carrot Cake/White Yeast BreadRachel makes a carrot cake decorated with orange cream cheese icing, finished off with delicate candied violets. She also meets Mich Turner, couture wedding cake-maker to the stars. The cookery school students learn the essential techniques of bread-making as Rachel shares her foolproof recipe, which uses fresh yeast.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — EdinburghJames and Tom are making their way to Edinburgh, but before they can do that, James makes a detour to Edradour whisky distillery in Pitlochry where he makes a delicious whisky chicken with wild mushroom and mustard sauce. Once they've reached Edinburgh, Tom shares his local knowledge by visiting one of his favourite suppliers, Welch Fishmongers. He learns the secret to their amazing smoked salmon which James uses for a salmon mousse with cucumber and dill pickle and Melba toast.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E5 — YorkshireThe time has come to cross the border from Scotland to England and where better to begin this leg of the journey than James' home country of Yorkshire. Here he's joined by Michelin starred chef Lisa Allen. His first stop is Whitby where he's popping into his favourite fish and chip shop before cooking tikka mackerel buns with fennel and apple salad for the crowds at Whitby bandstand. Lisa is paying a visit to The Black Swan.

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Weekday SupperMary Berry is throwing a casual weekday supper. Her Mediterranean platter of hummus, bread sticks, roasted vegetables and a tomato and mozzarella salad is perfect food for sharing on a summer's evening.

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Summer LunchFor Mary's outdoor party the dishes are best served cold. These include salmon fillets with herb sauce, ham with homemade chutney and fillet of beef with garlic and mustard cream. To accompany the cold meats and fish there are two salads.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S15 E5 — Merc StoryRee shares the epic tale of opening day at The Mercantile while making three get-ahead dinners. She cooks up butternut mac and cheese, Tuscan bean soup and ready-to-go chilli packets to turn into a trio of delicious standbys.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S15 E6 — Sharing ChocolateRee shares the good stuff with the chocolate lovers in her life, starting with a triple chocolate tiramisu for her best friend. Then, with her son's help, she makes crispy chocolate dippers to use in a crazy chocolate shake.

programme.title: Paul Hollywood City Bakes
programme.desc: S2 E10 — Cape TownPaul gets a guided tour around Cape Town's best baking hotspots from fellow Food Network star Siba Mtongana. Later, Paul creates two bakes of his own: Earl Grey milk tart and BBQ meat pasties.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Tommy BanksPrue welcomes award-winning chef Tommy Banks as she makes two-tone soups and is joined in the kitchen by her husband John for a goat curd and tomato galette.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S8 E4 — Triple D Goes Tailgaitin'Featuring chicken and waffles, double chilli cheeseburgers, steak sandwiches with jalapeño pesto and lastly, smoked pork chops with apple sauce.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S8 E5 — Home and AwaySautéed rib-eye with French fries; beef heart; fresh bread; schnitzel.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S8 E6 — By RequestFeaturing viewer favourites. In Charlotte, a fast food joint where the big hit is a double burger called the Super Boy. In Lakewood, Ohio, a neighbourhood favourite for grilled cheese sandwiches.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S8 E7 — And the Kicker Is..Handmade patties with fried green tomatoes; homemade bread; scrapple.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S1 E9 — New YorkAdam takes on the famed hottest curry in the country, Phaal Curry; 1-lb sandwich at Katz's Delicatessen.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S1 E10 — New OrleansAdam Richman heads to New Orleans, where he takes on a plate of 15 dozen oysters at Acme's Oyster House. Did he remember to bring a knife?

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: S11 — Dutch Windmill CakeBuddy Valastro and his cake crew are back and whipping up amazing cake creations. They prove that no matter how sticky the situation, the family that bakes together stays together.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: S11 E20 — Nikki's Wedding CakeBuddy receives a special order: his long-time employee, Nikki, is getting married. But being around cakes for years doesn't mean Nikki knows what she wants.

programme.title: Curtis Walker: NextUp Special
programme.desc: With a career that spans over 30 years, Curtis Walker is one of the UK's leading stand up comedians of modern times.

programme.title: Kate Barron: Losing Myself
programme.desc: Kate Barron performs her brand of stand-up comedy. The Canadian comedian speaks of her very personal story regarding how living in a new country in a global pandemic led her to taking drastic action.

programme.title: Sam Rhodes: The Colossus of Rhodes
programme.desc: Easy going, fun and endearingly weird, Sam presents a mix of whimsy, music and dad jokes that's as hilarious as it is unique.

programme.title: Joe Larson: Champion
programme.desc: Joe Larson, the son of a working comedian, started comedy at an early age and has always had a knack for making light of any situation.

programme.title: Don Barnhart: The Spinal Disintergration of Man
programme.desc: Barnhart explores modern day society in a way that is hysterical and thought-provoking.

programme.title: Don Friesen: Live in Provo
programme.desc: His kids think he's fun; his wife thinks he's an idiot; audiences think he's hilarious.

programme.title: Costaki Economopoulos: Now That I'm A Grown Up
programme.desc: For 20 years Costaki has been living his dream as a full-time stand up comic.

programme.title: Rex Havens: Women and Children First
programme.desc: Rex has been delighting comedy audiences for 20 years, in world-famous comedy clubs like The Improv, Catch-A-Rising Star, Funny Bones and Zanies, on television for Showtime, Comedy Central and Comic Relief, on radio with Bob & Tom and NPR, cruise ships worldwide, and corporate clients including GM, American Express, Texaco, 3M, Coca-Cola, IBM, Toshiba.

programme.title: Matt Knudsen: Good News
programme.desc: Matt Knudsen was born in Hawaii, raised in the Mid-west and sailed around the world as a merchant marine. As an actor, Matt shared the big screen with Oscar winner Sean Penn in Gangster Squad, or you may also recognise him from his appearances in shows like Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, Key & Peele, Workaholics, The League, Big Love, Boston Legal or Malcolm in the Middle just to name a few.

programme.title: Jessi Campbell: The Sharpest Knife on the Porch
programme.desc: Jessi Campbell has recently been seen on `Last Comic Standing'. She was the 2015 Campus Activities Magazine Female Performer of the Year, an award she was also nominated for in 2013.

programme.title: Eric O'Shea: Life: It's Not Your Fault!
programme.desc: Eric O'Shea has been active in the comedy business for 25 years. He has performed in LA with Betty White at the Creative Emmy Awards and has appeared on `America's Got Talent'.

programme.title: Drew Barth: Shoulda Tried Harder
programme.desc: Drew Barth is one of the fastest rising comedy stars in the Northwest.

programme.title: Drew Allen: Out of Ideas
programme.desc: Cursed with the ability to over-analyze even the most basic of human interactions, comedian Drew Allen has been delighting audiences with his distinct brand of anxious comedy since 2010.

programme.title: Dennis Regan: Dennisland
programme.desc: Dennis Regan performs his signature brand of observational comedy.

programme.title: Lisa Gilbert: All the Time Tired
programme.desc: Comedian Lisa Gilbert performs a standup set.

programme.title: John DeBoer: Put It on My Credit Card
programme.desc: Comedian John DeBoer performs standup.

programme.title: John Branyan: Demeaning of Life
programme.desc: Comedian John Branyan performs standup.

programme.title: Joey Callahan: The Notorious F.O.D.
programme.desc: Comedian Joey Callahan performs standup.

programme.title: Jesse Egan: That's the Spirit
programme.desc: Comedian Jesse Egan performs a standup show.

programme.title: Paul Lyons: You Are Looking at a Winner
programme.desc: Optimist Paul Lyons performs a night of standup comedy about how his dog influence his life.

programme.title: Andrew Rivers: Laffy Taffy
programme.desc: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business.

programme.title: The Traitor
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed by Michael McCarthy. Stars Anton Diffring And Christopher Lee. Survivors of a WW2 resistance group meet at a country house to find out which of them had betrayed their leader. [S]

programme.title: King Rat
programme.desc: 1965. War. Director: Bryan Forbes. Stars George Segal, Tom Courtenay And James Fox. A U.S. corporal operates a number of lucrative rackets within a WWII POW camp to have control and thrive in camp. [S]

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. Come To Me, My Litigation Baby! Classic crime series produced by Aaron Spelling and stars Anne Francis. Honey investigates a man who claims he was paralysed by falling down the stairs.

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Dead Man's Shoes. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Marjie Lawrence And Deborah Watling. Second Lieutenant Brian Ash joins his new regiment only to find that they are assigned to bomb disposal.

programme.title: The Adventures of Jim Bowie
programme.desc: Monsieur Francois. 1956. Stars Scott Forbes, Paul Playdon And Roger Til. Jim Bowie comes to the aid of a young French boy and his aunt who are being victimised by confidence tricksters. [S]

programme.title: Subway in the Sky
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Directed by Muriel Box. Starring Hildegard Knef, Katherine Kath And Van Johnson. A military doctor is falsely accused of dealing illegal drugs. Can he prove his innocence? [S]

programme.title: The Madame Gambles

programme.desc: E2In 1943, the mysterious murder of one of the wealthiest men in the British empire, Sir Harry Oakes, sparked a chain of events that have led many to believe that the Duke of Windsor had not learned from his mistakes.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Heinkel He 111 is one of the most recognised German aircraft of WW2. The broad winged design was a guinea pig for future bombers, with more variants than any other military aircraft of the time.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E3Examining the machines used by iconic military unit 'The Desert Rats' in the North African desert campaign of World War II.

programme.title: Cracking The Code
programme.desc: E3The Japanese Super Code reveals the US efforts to crack Japan's unbreakable WWII code following the horror of the attack on Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5John F Kennedy first made news in 1943 when, as a skipper of a torpedo boat in the Pacific, he and his crew were shipwrecked. We tell the story of their rescue.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6We explore two submarines – former Cold War enemies now moored in a Kent river, and discover the story of Vasili Arkhipov, a Soviet submariner who refused to authorise a nuclear launch.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3Often called 'the forgotten bomber', the mighty North American twin delivered the first blow in the fight back against Japan, in one of the most daring and audacious raids of all time.
